package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

type Counter struct {
	counts map[string]int
}

func NewCounter() *Counter {
	return &Counter{counts: make(map[string]int)}
}

func (c *Counter) Add(word string) {
	c.counts[strings.ToLower(word)]++
}

func main() {
	c := NewCounter()
	for _, w := range []string{"a", "b", "a"} {
		c.Add(w)
	}
	if len(c.counts) == 0 {
		return
	}
	fmt.Println(c.counts)
}
